question: Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath is the original name of which of the following Indian classical singers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Kumar Gandharva.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shivaputra Siddharamayya Komkalimath** is the **original name of Pandit Kumar Gandharva**, a renowned Indian classical singer.
 
• He was a **prominent figure in the Hindustani classical music tradition.**
 
• He made significant contributions to the world of music and was known for his unique style and innovations in classical singing.
 
• He received several awards for his outstanding contributions to Indian classical music, including the Padma Bhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.
 
• His innovative approach to music and his ability to transcend traditional boundaries left a lasting impact on the world of Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Omkarnath Thakur** was a highly **acclaimed Indian classical vocalist and musicologist**.

 
 
• He made significant contributions to Hindustani classical music and was recognized for his **expertise in the Gwalior and Agra gharanas** (musical traditions).
 
 
 
• **Pandit Jasraj** was a legendary Indian classical vocalist, renowned for his** mastery in the classical music traditions of North India**, particularly the **Mewati gharana.**
 
 
• He was one of the foremost classical vocalists of his time and made significant contributions to Hindustani classical music.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Dinkar Kaikini** was a **North Indian classical singer and composer.**
